deals_articles.title: Best Cannabis Deals This Week - Weedmaps Savings Guide
deals_articles.deck: Find the highest-quality products at the lowest prices. Updated weekly with deals across flower, edibles, vapes, and concentrates.

p: Cannabis is an investment, and smart shopping can cut your costs by 30-50%. But not all deals are equal—a cheap product might sacrifice quality, potency, or safety testing.
This guide shows you how to find genuine savings on high-quality products, and how to spot deals that are actually worth taking.
Best part: deals don't mean compromising. Many top brands run regular specials, and bulk deals on proven products offer better value than paying full price for unknown strains.

sections.h: Top deals by category this week

Edible Deals: Gummies and chocolates are heavily discounted this week, with 10-packs down $3-8. Perfect for new users trying different brands. → Shop Edible Deals
Vape Deals: Cartridges from major brands (1g full-spectrum) down $5-10. Stock up on your favorites—these don't last long in sales. → Shop Vape Deals
Concentrate Deals: This week's standout: wax at $12-18/gram (normally $25+). High quality, deep discounts. → Shop Concentrate Deals

sections.h: How to find the best deals (and avoid the traps)
p: Check the lab results. Real deals are on certified products with published lab data. If the lab report is missing, skip it—no matter how cheap.
Look at dates. Cannabis degrades over time. A deal on old inventory is a waste. Check the harvest/packaging date on the product details.
Compare per-unit cost. A $50 bundle that includes 5 products may actually be worse value than buying singles. Do the math.
Read reviews. Discounted products from trusted brands are real deals. Discounted products from unknown sellers might be clearance for a reason.
Buy only what you'll use. Bulk deals tempt you to overstock. Buy 2-3 weeks' worth, not 3 months'—quality declines in storage.
Flash Sales: 24-48 hour discounts on specific products. These are real bargains but limited stock. Buy immediately if interested.
Weekly Specials: Regular discounts on rotating products. Predictable timing—check every Monday or Friday for refreshes.
Bundle Deals: Buy 2+ products, save 15-25%. Good for sampling new brands or stocking up on favorites.
Loyalty Deals: Repeat customers get exclusive prices. Sign up for email lists to catch these.
Seasonal Sales: End-of-month or end-of-season clearance. Some of the year's best prices appear here.
First-Time Buyer Deals: New customer discounts (10-20% off) on your first order. Use these to test brands before committing.

sections.h: Save more: combine deals with smart shopping
p: Use the strain quiz to find products you'll actually enjoy, then buy them on sale. → Take the Strain Quiz
Stack deals: flash sale + bulk purchase + loyalty discount can add up to 50% off.
Buy high shelf-stability items on sale: flower, edibles, and concentrates store well. Avoid deep discounts on vapes that expire quickly.
Plan your purchases: if you know you'll need edibles next month, wait for the monthly flash sale rather than buying full-price now.
Read our dosing guides to make sure you're getting good value: a cheap gummy at 5mg isn't better value than a pricier one at 10mg. → Edibles Dosing Guide
Buying quantity over quality. A 50% discount on untested concentrate isn't a deal—it's a risk.
Ignoring expiration dates. Old cannabis loses potency and flavor. A 3-month-old deal is worse than a full-price fresh product.
Chasing novelty. New strain = higher price. Tried-and-true strains go on sale more often and are safer bets.
Not reading reviews. Cheap products from new brands often have quality issues hidden until reviews come in.
Impulse buying. A deal is only good if you'll actually use it. Overstocking leads to waste.
The best deal is a high-quality product at a fair price that you'll enjoy using.
Check lab results, read reviews, and compare per-unit cost before buying.
Weekly specials and flash sales are worth watching, but don't buy garbage just because it's cheap.

deals_articles.title: Cannabis Deals Near Me - Find Savings in Your Area
deals_articles.deck: Discover the best cannabis deals available in your region. Location-specific offers, delivery specials, and how to search by zip code.

p: Cannabis deals vary dramatically by region. A product that's $15 in California might be $25 in another state due to tax differences and local competition.
Delivery-specific deals are huge: free delivery, delivery fee waivers, and location-exclusive specials. Some shops offer different deals to different zip codes.
Your location determines which products are available, which brands operate there, and what the baseline prices are. Shopping smart means understanding your local market.

sections.h: How to search for deals by location
p: Use the postcode/zip code search on product pages to see what's available in your area.
Many deals are location-specific—same product, different prices in different zones.
Delivery minimums vary by area. A $30 order might qualify for free delivery in one zone but not another.
Check the estimated delivery time. Faster delivery (30-60 min) often has different deals than standard delivery (2-4 hours).
Some shops offer better deals during off-peak hours. Ordering at 3 PM might get you better prices than 7 PM.

sections.h: Delivery specials: the deals you might miss
p: Free Delivery: Look for orders over $40-50 qualifying for free delivery. Saves $3-8 per order.
Delivery Fee Waivers: Specific times or days when delivery is free regardless of order size.
Bundle Minimums: Buy 3 items, get free delivery. Buy 5, get 15% off. These add up fast.
First-Order Specials: New customer? Free delivery on your first order, plus product discounts.
Loyalty Programs: Repeat customers often get free delivery after 5-10 purchases.
High-competition areas (major cities): More deals, lower prices due to competition. Shop around—different vendors offer different specials.
Lower-competition areas: Fewer deals but also less price variation. Lock in loyalty with one vendor for better pricing.
Seasonal variations: Summer = lower prices (more inventory). Winter = sometimes higher prices or fewer deals.
Tax differences: High-tax states have higher baseline prices. Focus on percentage discounts, not dollar amounts.

sections.h: Timing: when to buy in your area
p: Monday deals: Many shops refresh inventory Monday and offer deals to clear weekend stock.
Friday happy hour: Some shops offer 4-7 PM specials to drive evening traffic.
End-of-month clearance: Last week of the month often has the biggest deals.
First-of-month restocks: Shops refresh inventory and sometimes offer grand-reopening-style deals.
Off-peak hours: 9 AM - 2 PM often has better deals than evening peak hours.

sections.h: Comparing deals across shops near you
p: Don't just pick the closest shop. Compare prices on your favorite products across 2-3 nearby vendors.
Factor in delivery time and fees. Shop A might be closer but Shop B might have free delivery.
Check loyalty programs. 10 purchases at Shop A might get you better rewards than occasional visits to Shop B.
Read recent reviews. New shops sometimes offer deep discounts to build reviews—can be a good deal.
Use our strain quiz to identify what you want, then shop the deal. → Take the Strain Quiz

sections.h: Pro tips for local deal hunting
p: Sign up for email lists from 2-3 local vendors. You'll see deals before they appear on the website.
Follow local shops on social media (Instagram, Facebook) for flash deals announced only there.
Call ahead on slow days (Tuesday-Wednesday) and ask if they're running specials.
Buy in bulk on sale. If a product you love is 30% off, stock up (but only if it stores well).
Ask about first-time customer deals. Many shops offer 15-25% off your first order.

deals_articles.title: Best Concentrate Deals - Quality Products at Lower Prices
deals_articles.deck: Find the highest-quality concentrates on sale. Wax, rosin, and distillate deals with full lab testing verified.

sections.h: What concentrates are (and why deals matter more here)
p: Concentrates are cannabis products where most of the non-active plant material has been removed, leaving a potent product with 50-99% THC/CBD.
Because concentrates are potent and expensive ($20-80 per gram), deals here can save you real money—$5-15 per gram adds up fast if you use them regularly.
The catch: concentrate quality varies hugely. A cheap concentrate from an untested producer might be low-potency or contaminated. A deal is only good if it's lab-verified.
Wax: Whipped during extraction, has a creamy texture. Easiest to handle. Good for deals because it's stable and doesn't degrade quickly.
Shatter: Hard, glass-like concentrate. Highest potency per gram. Premium product—deals are rare but worth catching.
Rosin: Pressed directly from flower, retains all terpenes. Best flavor. Premium price, but occasional deals make it accessible.
Distillate: Purified cannabinoids. Mild flavor but extremely potent. Budget-friendly and holds its value in sales.
Live Resin: Made from fresh-frozen material, highest terpene content. Premium flavor and effects. Rare to find on sale—jump on it when you do.
→ Read our full concentrates guide

sections.h: How to find quality concentrates on sale
p: Always check the lab report. Real deals are certified products with testing that shows: potency (THC %), terpene profile, and safety (pesticides, heavy metals, microbials).
Look for full-spectrum testing, not just potency. A concentrate with documented terpenes tastes and feels better than pure THC.
Harvest date matters more for concentrates than flower. Concentrates degrade faster. Don't buy old inventory even if discounted.
Producer reputation: deals on unknown brands are risky. Established brands' discounts are safer bets.
Compare per-unit potency. A $12 gram at 85% THC is better value than a $10 gram at 60% THC.
Under $12/gram: Budget concentrates, usually wax or distillate. Decent potency (70-80% THC) but lower terpene profiles. Good for learning the category.
$12-18/gram: Best value range. Solid wax, good potency (80-85%), reliable producers. Most regular deals land here.
$18-30/gram: Premium concentrates. Rosin, live resin, full-spectrum. Better flavor and effects. Occasional deals make it worth waiting for.
$30+/gram: Ultra-premium. Rare rosin, high-terpene live resin. Deals here are rarer but sometimes happen on bulk purchases.
→ Shop Concentrate Deals

sections.h: Bulk deals: how to save big on concentrates
p: Buy 2 grams, save 10%. Buy 5 grams, save 20%. Bulk discounts on concentrates are common and add up fast.
Stock up on favorites: Concentrates store well (6+ months in cool, dark conditions). A 5-gram bulk deal saves you $10-25.
Mix-and-match deals: Buy 5 grams across different types (2g wax, 2g rosin, 1g distillate) and get a discount. Great for exploring.
Weekly specials: Some shops rotate which concentrate type is on sale each week. Plan ahead if you know your favorites.
Loyalty programs: Repeat concentrate buyers often unlock tier-2 pricing (15-25% off) after 5-10 purchases.

sections.h: Safety: what to look for in concentrate deals
p: Lab tested, always. If there's no certificate of analysis, don't buy it, regardless of price.
Check for residual solvents (for BHO/PHO products). Safe levels are <2 ppm per solvent; your lab report should list this.
Pesticide screen: should show "non-detect" on all tested pesticides.
Heavy metals: lead, cadmium, mercury should all be below limits. Concentrates that bio-accumulate these matter more than flower.
Microbial testing: E. coli, salmonella, listeria should all be negative.
→ How to Read a Lab Report
Buying purely on price. A $8/gram concentrate is cheap for a reason—likely low potency or quality.
Ignoring potency differences. A $15 gram at 90% THC is way better value than a $10 gram at 60% THC.
Buying distillate thinking it's rosin. Distillate is cheaper and less flavorful; don't confuse it with premium rosin.
Overstocking. Concentrates last 6+ months but flavor degrades over time. Buy 2-4 weeks' worth, not 3 months'.
Skipping the lab report. A discount that saves $3 but costs you contamination risk is not a deal.
Best concentrate deals are 40-50% off normal prices, usually on wax or bulk purchases.
Always verify lab testing before buying, even on sale.
Established brands' discounts ($12-18/gram for quality wax) are better value than rock-bottom prices from unknowns.
Bulk deals and loyalty programs are where you find the best per-gram pricing.

deals_articles.deck: Find quality edibles at deep discounts. Gummies, chocolate, drinks and more with full dosing information.

sections.h: Why edibles are perfect for deal shopping
p: Edibles are popular, which means high volume and frequent deals. You'll see sales on edibles 2-3x more often than flower.
Edibles are shelf-stable. Unlike flower or vapes, you can safely stock up on sale purchases—they last 6+ months.
Many edible brands offer bulk deals: buy 2-3 packages, get 20-30% off. Perfect for trying multiple brands or stocking up on favorites.
First-time buyer deals are huge on edibles: many shops offer 15-25% off if you're trying them for the first time.
Gummies: Most popular, come in 5-10mg pieces. Easy to dose, taste good, affordable. Most common on sale.
Chocolates: Premium feel, best for gifting or special occasions. Slightly higher price, less frequent deals.
Mints/Lozenges: Discreet, small portion sizes. Good for testing dosages.
Beverages: Drinks, teas, coffees. Newer category with growing deals.
Baked goods: Cookies, brownies, etc. Highest price point, rarest on sale.
→ Full Edibles Guide with Dosing
Start with 5-10mg THC gummies. Even on sale, they're perfect for learning your tolerance.
Buy variety packs on sale (5-10 different brands in one bundle). Best way to find your favorite at a discount.
Combine deals: first-time discount + bulk discount + flash sale = 50%+ off your first order.
Avoid mega-high potency deals if you're new. A 50mg gummy at 30% off isn't a good deal if it's too strong for you.
→ Cannabis for Beginners: Edibles Edition

sections.h: Dosing matters: don't underpay for weak edibles
p: 5mg THC: Beginner dose, good for testing tolerance or daytime use.
10mg THC: Standard dose for most experienced users, good value sweet spot.
20mg THC: Double dose, better value per mg. Good for evening use.
A $10 gummy with 10mg is the same value as a $5 gummy with 5mg (both $1/mg). Compare per-mg cost, not just price.
Buy higher-dose edibles on sale: 20mg gummies at 30% off are better value than 5mg at 20% off.
→ Complete Edibles Dosing Guide
Under $5 per package: Budget gummies from lesser-known brands. Decent quality but basic flavors. Good for stocking up.
$5-8 per package: Mid-range gummies from known brands. Best value for quality. Where most deals cluster.
$8-12 per package: Premium gummies or chocolates. Better ingredients, better taste. Occasional sales here.
$12+ per package: Ultra-premium or specialized (vegan, keto, etc.). Rare on sale—when they go on sale, grab them.
→ Shop Edible Deals
10-pack variety bundles: Try 10 different gummies at a discount. Best way to find your favorite brand.
Buy 2+ packages, save 15%. Buy 5+, save 25%. Standard edible deal structure.
Mixed potency packs: 5 gummies at 5mg + 5 at 10mg in one package. Great for trying different dosages.
Flavor rotation deals: Shop clears old flavors—buy 3 packages of mixed flavors at a discount.
Monthly subscriptions: Some shops offer 20-30% off if you subscribe to monthly edible deliveries.
Loyalty programs: 10 purchases = tier 2 pricing at 15% off.
Lab tested: check for potency verification. 10mg should actually contain 10mg (within ±10%).
Check the expiration date. Edibles last 6-12 months but best within 6 months.
Read reviews on the brand. Edibles are subjective—does it taste good? Does it kick in on time?
Avoid ultra-old inventory. If an edible is discounted because it's 10 months old, pass.
→ How to Read a Certificate of Analysis
Edibles are the most frequently discounted product category—check weekly for sales.
Best deals are $5-8 per 10-pack gummies (50-60% off full price).

deals_articles.deck: Master guide to finding and maximizing savings. Deal types, strategies, timing, and how to stack discounts.

p: Flash Sales: 24-48 hour deep discounts (30-50% off) on specific products. Limited stock. Buy immediately if interested.
Weekly Specials: Rotating products on sale every week. Predictable—check Mondays and Fridays for refreshes.
Bundle Deals: Buy 2+ items, save 15-25%. Great for trying new categories or stocking up.
Loyalty Discounts: Repeat customers unlock tier-based pricing (10-25% off after 5-10 purchases).
Seasonal Clearance: End-of-month or end-of-season deep discounts (40-60% off) on overstocked items.
First-Time Buyer Deals: New customer discounts (15-25% off entire order). Signup bonus codes.
Free Delivery: Free shipping on orders over $40-50, or specific delivery days with free fees.
Birthday/Holiday Specials: Customer appreciation discounts during holidays or on your birthday.

sections.h: Deal strategies that actually save money
p: Strategy 1: Know Your Favorites First. Use the Strain Quiz to identify products you'll love, then buy them on sale instead of full price. → Take Strain Quiz
Strategy 2: Stack Multiple Discounts. Flash sale (30% off) + bulk purchase (15% off) + loyalty tier (10% off) = 50%+ total savings.
Strategy 3: Buy High-Shelf-Stability Items on Sale. Flower, edibles, concentrates store 6+ months. Vapes degrade faster—buy vapes full price, edibles on sale.
Strategy 4: Plan Ahead. Know when your favorites go on sale and buy in bulk. Most shops have predictable sale cycles.
Strategy 5: Loyalty Programs Pay Off. The 10th purchase at a shop often comes with tier-2 pricing (15-25% off going forward).
Strategy 6: Compare Per-Unit Cost. A $5 product at 50% off isn't better than a $6 product at 20% off. Do the math.
Strategy 7: Follow Social Media. Flash deals appear on Instagram/Facebook before the website. Sign up for email lists.
Daily: Check during off-peak hours (9 AM - 2 PM). Some shops offer mid-day deals to drive traffic.
Weekly: Mondays (inventory refresh) and Fridays (end-of-week specials) are peak deal days.
Monthly: Last week of month has biggest clearance deals. First week sometimes has grand-reopening style specials.
Seasonally: Summer = lower prices (peak inventory). Winter = sometimes higher prices.
Holidays: End-of-holiday sales are deep (40-50% off). Holiday season itself has higher baseline prices.
After you join loyalty: After 5-10 purchases, pricing locks in 15-25% lower going forward.
Flower Deals: Expect 20-30% off during weekly specials. Bulk purchases (eighth or more) get better pricing. → Flower Deals
Edible Deals: Most frequent deal category. 30-50% off common. Bulk deals (buy 5+ packages) go to 25% off. → Edible Deals
Vape Deals: Less frequent than edibles. 20-30% off when on sale. Skip these and wait for specials—they don't store well.
Concentrate Deals: Deep discounts (30-50% off) on wax/distillate, rarer on premium rosin. Per-gram pricing matters more than sticker price. → Concentrate Deals
Bundles: Pre-made bundles (3-5 products together) often have 20-30% off. Good for sampling.

sections.h: How to combine deals for maximum savings
p: Step 1: Find a flash sale on a category you love.
Step 2: Buy bulk from that sale (3+ items instead of 1).
Step 3: Use a loyalty discount if you qualify (every 10th purchase).
Step 4: Add free delivery by hitting the order minimum.
Result: 30% (flash) + 15% (bulk) + 10% (loyalty) + $5 (delivery) saved = 50%+ off your normal spend.
Pro: The best deals require planning. Set a 2-week reminder to check your favorite shop's specials.

sections.h: Mistakes that waste money on deals
p: Buying quantity over quality. A 50% discount on untested concentrate isn't savings—it's a gamble.
Ignoring expiration dates. A 6-month-old edible at 30% off will taste stale by the time you use it.
Impulse buying. A deal is only good if you'll actually use it. Overstocking leads to waste and lost money.
Not comparing per-unit cost. A cheap product at a worse per-unit price wastes money even if it looks discounted.
Buying vapes on sale. Vapes degrade in storage. Buy what you'll use within 30 days at full price instead.
Chasing novelty. New strains cost more and rarely go on sale. Proven strains have more frequent deals.
Missing loyalty tiers. 10 purchases at Shop A gets you permanent 15% off. Switching shops resets this progress.

sections.h: The math: when a deal is actually worth it
p:
Example 1: Edibles
- Full price: $10 per 10-pack (10mg each) = $1 per mg
- On sale: 30% off = $7 per 10-pack = $0.70 per mg
- Savings: $3 per pack, $30 per 10-pack order = Worth buying

Example 2: Flower
- Full price: $15 per eighth (20% THC) = $0.75 per mg
- On sale: 20% off = $12 per eighth = $0.60 per mg
- Savings: $3 per eighth, $24 per ounce order = Worth buying

Example 3: Concentrates
- Full price: $25 per gram (85% THC) = $0.29 per mg
- On sale: 40% off = $15 per gram = $0.18 per mg
- Savings: $10 per gram, $50 per 5-gram order = Definitely worth buying
Rule: If it's more than 20% off and you'll use it within its shelf life, it's probably worth buying.
Beginners: Focus on first-time buyer deals (15-25% off) and variety packs. Learn what you like before buying in bulk.
Occasional Users: Monthly flash sales on edibles and pre-rolls. Don't need to chase every deal—2-3 purchases a month is enough.
Regular Users: Join loyalty programs, hit tier-2 pricing after 10 purchases (15-25% off ongoing). Track when your favorites go on sale.
Heavy Users: Build relationships with 2-3 shops. Negotiate better pricing or get early notice of sales.
